title: Mount a zoom lens nose-down and retain 50 mm
instruction: Choose one zoom lens compatible with the right camera, mount it on the downward-facing camera, align the index marks, and turn it to the physical lock. Set it to 50 mm and release all cameras and lenses. Keep the focal length within 48–52 mm for the final continuous 20 seconds with hands off. A seated but unlocked lens earns nothing. Do not overload a mount or drop any lens.
context: Camera servicing requires compatible lens selection and retention against gravity; the two compatible lenses have different zoom friction.
setup: One fixed source-seed-42 physical case: two original camera bodies, three free zoom lenses, two foam trays and an overhead bracket. Every task shape receives the translation (0.25, 0, -0.0525) m. The right mount seat is (0.40, 0.28, 1.2475) m and faces down. Two genuine six-joint YAM arms stand at (0, +/-0.305, 0.90) m on 200 x 200 x 152.5 mm rigid supports. Fingers retain 40 N; total shoulder/wrist limits including gravity are 27/7 N m. Exact dimensions, masses, materials, poses, station parts and reset are in b6-v30/candidate/setup-inventory.json, b6-v30/candidate/fixture.json and README.md. The table top is z=0.7475 m; pedestal tops meet both bases at z=0.90 m. The overhead camera rear housing contacts the rigid crossbar at z=1.3175 m. Fixed-fixture assumptions and numeric contact surfaces are documented in README.
scoring: 1.0: a compatible lens is seated (axial gap <=1 mm, radial offset <=2.5 mm, tilt <=4 degrees), physically captured and pin-locked within 4 degrees, at 48–52 mm throughout the final continuous 20 seconds without robot contact on any camera or lens. 0.5: a compatible lens is seated and locked throughout that final hands-off period, but the focal setting is not maintained in 48–52 mm. Otherwise 0. Any unmounted/unheld lens falling downward faster than 0.6 m/s, stop/pin reaction above 1.5 N m for 50 ms, wrist force above 80 N for 100 ms, or invalid/missing telemetry vetoes all credit.
run_limit: 3,034 controls at 20 Hz (151.7 simulated seconds), including the final 20-second hands-off hold. Ends on physical failure, verified full success, or budget.
reset_notes: Reset to the fixed source-seed-42 layout with no object jitter. Restore original object roots and ten task-joint positions/velocities, ready/open robot arms, disabled capture/pin constraints and 18 mm zoom; settle before clearing episode history. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Estimated-parameter rigid PhysX camera-service mockup; no optical image formation or measured real-camera calibration. Hinges/slides, authored SI joint friction and an energy-paired finite-stiffness zoom helix model passive creep. Contact-triggered capture/pin constraints approximate bayonet engagement; full normal+tangential robot contacts drive pull-out. Robot supports and overhead camera fixture are rigid fixed fixtures. See README for dimensions and limits.
scores: Dream-1 beta + public gripper saturation [0,1]: 0.0 (3,034 steps, 751 requests, one continuous session); scripted demo: 1.0 (2,402 steps).
